anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The month is both beginning and first.

pass_a_gloss: The beginning then not in every way having the first, but the first in every way having the beginning, he says this month is beginning of months and first of the months of the year for them.
pass_b_english: Since then a beginning does not in every case have the first, but the first in every case has the beginning, he says that this month is a beginning of months and first of the months of the year for them (Exodus 12:2).
source_text: Τῆς οὖν ἀρχῆς ο[ὐ] πάντως ἐχούσης τὸ πρῶ[τον], τοῦ δὲ πρώτου πάντως ἔ[χοντ]ος τὴν ἀρχήν, λέγει τ[ὸν μ]ῆνα τοῦτον ἀρχὴν μη[νῶ]ν καὶ πρῶτον τῶν μηνῶ[ν τ]οῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ αὐτοῖς εἶνα[ι].
